description: This file provides French localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when loading results fail.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message when input exceeds maximum length, suggesting characters to remove.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message when input is shorter than the minimum required length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message when selection exceeds maximum allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message when search is in progress.
